- Use ATTACK button to destroy enemies. Press both ATTACK and JUMP buttons simultaneously for jump shot.

- Capture and defuse all the time bombs to complete each stage. + Power-up features: GRENADE DISC --- Get your power doubled. MOVER FUEL -- Fly using jet pack for a limited period. During this period you cannot be killed.

- Continuation is available by inserting additional coins and press start button. ~ Bonus quiz: There are English quiz stages after 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 6th stages. (Available by DIP SWITCH settting.) Answer as much as you can for bonus points.
